user.title: Aqara Presence Lab
user.description: Add cloud observations to your local Aqara sensors. Your existing HomeKit connection and automations remain independent. This release includes an offline preview; continuous cloud access requires a reviewed protocol and account identity.

offline.title: Offline preview — historical examples
offline.description: Historical example data from 25 September 2026: Sensor A reported 9 lx, Sensor B 110 lx. Both presence candidates contained the raw code 0; its meaning and freshness are unverified. These examples create no devices, entities or network requests. Coordinates, person count and sleep data are not available.

credentials.title: Existing session (EU)
credentials.description: EU only. Enter an existing Aqara session locally and explicitly list device IDs (one per line). No password or automatic login is used. Credentials are stored in Home Assistant configuration; protect administration and backups. A server-validated account identity and reviewed protocol are required before a device read.

devices.title: Devices and polling
devices.description: Select the devices whose cloud responses were received. The interval applies to one shared account batch. Illuminance is the last reported cloud value; it is not a promise of a current physical measurement.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew session
reauth_confirm.description: The Aqara session needs renewal. Your devices and history remain in place. Enter a session for the same account locally; the existing selection is checked before credentials are replaced.

reconfigure.title: Device selection and interval
reconfigure.description: Choose device IDs and the shared polling interval. The existing account identity is checked. Existing local HomeKit devices and areas remain independent.

error.invalid_capture: The export is incomplete or not a single JSON document. Export it again locally; do not post credentials.
error.missing_credentials: The session is missing required information. Complete the local fields.
error.signature_unverified: This protocol has not passed the required live, identity and subscription tests. Use the offline preview and follow the local validation guide; continuous cloud polling is disabled.
error.signature_rejected: The signed request was rejected. Check the session, protocol profile and clock; repeated logins will not resolve an unverified signature.
error.cannot_connect: Aqara is temporarily unreachable. The integration will respect its retry delay.
error.rate_limited: Aqara is limiting requests. Wait for the shared cooldown before trying again.
error.auth_required: Renew the Aqara session for the configured account.
error.account_mismatch: This session belongs to a different account. Use the configured account; existing devices have not been reassigned.
error.no_selected_device_data: No usable response was received for the selection. Check the device IDs and Aqara app mode.
error.freshness_unverified: A cloud value was reported, but its physical measurement freshness is unverified.
error.api_changed: Aqara returned an unrecognized response. Check the protocol and use the sanitized diagnostic export.
error.unsupported_region: Only the observed EU region is supported. No other regional host will be tried.
error.invalid_device_ids: Enter one to 100 device IDs, one per line, without whitespace inside an ID.
error.invalid_interval: Choose an interval from 60 to 3600 seconds.
error.protocol_unsupported: Continuous cloud access is disabled because the required protocol and account evidence is not verified.

abort.offline_complete: Offline preview finished. No devices, entities or connections were created.
abort.already_configured: This Aqara account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The session was renewed for the same account.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The device selection and interval were updated.
abort.signature_unverified: This protocol has not passed the required live, identity and subscription tests. Use the offline preview and follow the local validation guide; continuous cloud polling is disabled.
abort.no_selected_device_data: No usable response was received for the selection. Check the device IDs and Aqara app mode.
abort.account_mismatch: This session belongs to a different account. Use the configured account; existing devices have not been reassigned.
